meadow.line: Now I'm rambling through this meadow
stanza: Now I'm rambling through this meadow
Happy as a man can be
Think I'll just lay me down
If you've got a truffle dog

meadow.songTitle: O Wow O Wow (How Wonderful She Is)
meadow.line: The country doctor whistles across the meadow

meadow.line: From the magnolia trees in the meadow
stanza: From the magnolia trees in the meadow

meadow.line: I hears it in de meadow
stanza: I hears it in de meadow
And I hears it in de grove
